title: 南国の果物
subject_en: Tropical fruits, each ONE fruit (whole or one cut half beside it) centred in its cell, flat vector style with clean shapes and simple highlights, bright natural colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (flesh, seeds, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ドラゴンフルーツ・マンゴー・ライチなど南国の果物を、フラットなタッチで描いた12点です。メニューや商品紹介、食育の資料に使えます。
items: a pink dragon fruit with green scales, with a cut half showing white flesh and black seeds
a ripe mango, orange-red and yellow, with a cut half showing the flesh in a grid
a papaya cut in half lengthwise showing orange flesh and black seeds
three lychees with rough red skin, one peeled to show the pale flesh
a purple passion fruit with a cut half showing yellow pulp and seeds
a brown coconut with a cut half showing white flesh, with a straw in it
a dark purple mangosteen with a cut half showing white segments, green calyx on top
a green guava with a cut half showing pink flesh and seeds
a cluster of red rambutans with soft green-tipped hairs, one peeled
a yellow-green star fruit with a cross-section slice showing a star shape
a whole pineapple with a green crown, next to a ring slice
a spiky green-brown durian with a cut section showing pale yellow pods
